Claire — thanks for the questionnaire and inventory. Below is a concise summary of Redwood’s standard practice for pen tests and vuln management; happy to expand on any point or get on a short call to align the scope.

Pen test & report handling (standard)- Scope: customer-visible endpoints + ingestion pipelines. Internal infra is scannable if customer provides IPs/VPC ranges; we coordinate staging environments where possible.- Report sharing: we provide a redacted PDF of the full pen-test report to the customer within 7 business days of vendor handback. For critical findings we provide an initial triage summary within 48 hours.- Disclosure: Redwood uses coordinated disclosure — we privately share details with the customer and the vendor (when third-party components implicated), and we require mutual triage windows before public disclosure.

Vulnerability management SLA (what we commit to customers)- Critical (CVSS 9.0–10.0 or exploitable RCE): initial mitigation plan within 72 hours; full remediation or mitigations with timeline within 30 calendar days.- High (CVSS 7.0–8.9): remediation plan within 14 calendar days; remediation within 60 days typical.- Medium/Low: tracked and remediated as part of quarterly backlog cycles; exceptions logged.

Scanning cadence & tooling- Quarterly third-party pen tests recommended for customers with PHI/PII.- Internal automated auth/vulnerability scans: weekly authenticated scans for critical surfaces; daily SCA for dependency vulnerabilities.- Optional: continuous external monitoring and managed bug bounty (we can coordinate introductions).

Artifacts we can provide now- Redacted pen-test report template (redwood-pen-report-process.pdf)- Vulnerability disclosure playbook (redwood-vuln-disclosure-playbook.pdf)

NDA / DPA- We have a standard penetration-test NDA and an updated DPA for HIPAA/GDPR that we can sign — we typically execute the NDA prior to handoff of sensitive data. DocuSign link available on request.

If this matches your expectations, Mateo — can you confirm we should schedule a kickoff window in the week of 6/7? I’ll also include our security-eng PM to coordinate vendor access and any staging requirements.

—Steph
